question: Which club had the most separate injury spells recorded in 2023-2024?
answer: Chelsea had the most separate injury spells recorded in 2023-2024, with 61 injury spells.
sql:
SELECT
  COALESCE(t.team_name, pis.team) AS club,
  COUNT(pis.spell_id) AS injury_spells
FROM player_injury_spells pis
LEFT JOIN teams t
  ON t.team_name = pis.team
WHERE pis.season = '2023-2024'
  AND pis.league_code = 'ENG-PL'
GROUP BY COALESCE(t.team_name, pis.team)
ORDER BY injury_spells DESC
LIMIT 1;

out.notes: Use player_injury_spells at one row per injury/absence spell. Filter season='2023-2024' and league_code='ENG-PL'; group by team and count spell_id to count separate spells, then order DESC LIMIT 1. Join to teams only if canonicalising/displaying club names, since player_injury_spells stores team as text and has no team_id.
